history.content: Hi! I want to talk about my hobby. I like reading books, especially fantasy.
Oh, fantasy books are a great choice! Which author do you like most?
My favourite is Tolkien. I have read The Hobbit three times.
Three times! What makes you come back to it?
Yes, I also like films based on books, but the books is usually better.
I agree, books usually go deeper. Do you prefer reading in English or in Russian?
